Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

aedes 0.5

This version adds local synapse snapshots: a downloadable copy of the full synapse table that aedes_partner_summary() (and so coconatfly) can query much faster than CAVE, at the latest materialisation or any later time including now. See the new synapse snapshots vignette. Note also that the default aedes.version is now "now", and that aedes_set_group(group = 0) no longer ungroups (use group = NA).

  • New aedes_synapse_data(), a lazy DuckDB table of all synapses in a local snapshot, optionally with supervoxel, position and size details. (#27)
  • aedes_partner_summary() gains method = c("auto", "cave", "local"); auto answers from a local snapshot when one is selected. (#27)
  • Local partner queries work at any time after the snapshot, including timestamp = "now", by bringing snapshot rows forward with CAVE edit history. Results match CAVE. (#29)
  • New aedes_use_snapshot(), aedes_update_snapshot(), aedes_build_snapshot() and aedes_snapshot_root() to select, update, build and locate snapshots. aedes_use_snapshot() follows aedes.version when no tag is given. (#32, #33)
  • New aedes_download_snapshot() and aedes_publish_snapshot(). The download address is worked out from CAVE, so no URL is needed. (#33, #34)
  • Snapshots are stored as an append-only chain of checkpoints, kept up to date by a server cron job (inst/scripts/synsnap-cron.sh) that makes one checkpoint a day. New aedes.duckdb_threads option. (#30, #35, #36)
  • New checkpoints are downloaded automatically, checking the server at most every aedes.snapshot_check_hours hours (default 6). (#36)
  • aedes_synapse_data(timestamp=) brings a snapshot forward to the requested time in memory, without writing to disk. (#36, #38)
  • Smaller snapshot files: one root id file, zstd level 19 parquet and no centroid columns (static.parquet 2.9 GB to 1.8 GB). (#28, #31)
  • Fixes for empty integer64 lookups on older bit64 (#39) and downloads of manifests listing only full snapshots (#40).
  • aedes_predict_group() takes the type-derived id from the whole aedes_main table, so a neuron’s pgroup no longer depends on which other neurons are in the query. (#45)
  • Documentation audit: corrected examples and descriptions, the synapse snapshot docs, and a new Axis conventions section in aedes_neuropil_mesh documenting the mirrored Aedes axes. (#44)
  • aedes_add_neurons(initials=) sets the initials written to annotator/proofreader, and initials is no longer a required column (aedes_main has none). (#43)
  • aedes_set_meta(), aedes_set_group() and aedes_add_neurons() never update rows marked duplicate, bad_nucleus or not_a_neuron: a neuron that also has a normal row is matched to that row, while one with only such rows is skipped with a message (and not re-added). These rows no longer count as group members either. (#42)
  • aedes_set_group(group = "<query>") resolves the example neurons at the same pinned timestamp as the rest of the call, so recently edited examples are found. (#42)
  • aedes_add_neurons(soma=) also accepts an aedes_soma_position() method name, e.g. soma = "nucleus" to fill soma/nucleus only from the nucleus table. (#42)
  • New proofreading edit history vignette. Fixes wrong operation ids in the edit cache for multi-chunk fetches (existing caches should be rebuilt) and the last-edit search stopping at gaps in operation ids. (#41)
  • aedes.version now defaults to "now" (set on load unless already set), and CAVE partner queries follow it. aedes_ids() / aedes_meta() return FlyTable ids as is unless version/timestamp is given. (#37)
  • cf_ids(aedes=) reports explicit ids that are replaced by older roots to match a version or timestamp. (#37)
  • New aedes_predict_group() returns a group id per neuron (from type, then group, then NBLAST cluster) for partner grouping in connectivity clustering. (#22)
  • coconatfly metadata includes this as a pgroup column, so cf_cosine_plot(group = "pgroup") works directly; new connectivity clustering vignette comparing group and pgroup. (#25)
  • aedes_predict_group() uses nblast_group clusters of the form CNNNNN or NNNNN. (#25, #26)
  • aedes_ids() / aedes_meta() accept neuroglancer URLs and comma-separated id strings. Requires fafbseg (>= 0.15.19). (#24)
  • aedes_add_neurons(side=) also accepts a character side value, written directly instead of auto-filling. (#23)
  • Valid superclasses in aedes_add_neurons() examples and error hints. (#21)
  • Group ids: NA is the ungrouped sentinel. Breaking: aedes_set_group(group = 0) is now an error; use group = NA. Root ids are rejected as group ids by aedes_set_group() and aedes_add_neurons(), and ungrouped neurons no longer read back as group 0. (#20)
  • coconatfly adapter (cf_meta()/cf_partners()): ungrouped neurons now reach coconatfly as an integer64 NA group, so cf_cosine_plot(group="group") drops them instead of collapsing every ungrouped partner into one spurious shared feature column. (#19)
  • aedes_add_neurons() writes root_id and supervoxel_id for new rows, so re-adding a neuron updates its row rather than creating a duplicate. (#18)
  • aedes_add_neurons() gains a group argument: TRUE groups the new neurons after insertion, or give an explicit group id. (#18)

Committed directly to main:

  • cf_ids(aedes=) ignores leading/trailing commas in id lists. (bade4c7)
  • Drop unused igraph from Imports. (a700e27)
  • Synapse snapshot vignette polishing and pkgdown image fix (8c3fad7, f7006d6).

aedes 0.4

This version includes substantial improvements to the functions for handling flytable metadata (especially aedes_add_neurons()), which should now provide an efficient approach to add newrows including automatic definition of key points on the neuron, soma location, side of brain etc.

  • New aedes_set_meta() bulk-updates existing flytable rows. (#10)
  • New aedes_set_group() sets group to lowest serial_id (but maintains selected serial number if joining an existing group in the table). (#10)
  • aedes_add_neurons() enrichment: auto-fill soma_xyz/nucleus_id/side/point_xyz and require superclass/status/initials on new rows; also adds annotator/proofreader multi-select handling. (#10)
  • aedes_meta() gains a translate_ids argument to ensure incoming ids match the requested materialisation state so that rows are reliably selected. (#10)
  • aedes_add_neurons() accepts a data.frame ids carrying a root_id column plus per-row metadata (one value per id, vs. the recycled scalars of ...); a data.frame column naming an auto-fill field overrides the auto-fill and skips the corresponding soma/side service call. (#17)
  • aedes_meta() / aedes_ids() default expiry = 0 and document expiry/refresh, so metadata reads are fresh by default. Requires fafbseg (>= 0.15.17). (#16)
  • aedes_add_neurons(): robust handling of ids that collapse to one neuron after pinning — recycled scalars drop the duplicate with a warning, per-id values are a hard error. (#15)
  • New aedes_partner_summary(), an Aedes-aware wrapper around fafbseg::flywire_partner_summary() (one row per synaptic partner). (#14)
  • aedes_key_point() delegates to fafbseg::flywire_key_point() / key_point_from_neuron(), becoming a thin with_aedes() wrapper. (#13)
  • aedes_flytable_update(): don’t flag NA root_ids as duplicated. (#12)
  • aedes_flytable_update(): only write columns that can change, treat NA root_duplicated as FALSE, and return the changed-rows data frame. (#11)
  • New aedes_soma_side() / aedes_point_side(); predict the side of a point or soma. (#9)

Committed directly to main:

  • aedes_xyz2id() now defaults to mip = 1 (the LMB transform service dropped scale 0). (fbdbc71)
  • Docs: clarify the three aedes_main editing functions (c25ff33); add a citation and Zenodo badge (d768f1c).

Full diff: https://github.com/flyconnectome/aedes/compare/v0.3...v0.4

aedes v0.3

  • New aedes_add_neurons() for upserting rows in the FlyTable aedes_main table. Pins a single materialisation timestamp on both the supplied ids and a fresh aedes_meta(expiry=0) read so the join-by-root_id is reliable, and computes point_xyz for new rows via aedes_key_point(). Avoids the heavy aedes_flytable_update() pass. (#8)
  • New aedes_key_point() returns a “good” annotation point on a neuron: the principal branch point of its L2 skeleton, with the neuron optionally rerooted onto its furthest endpoint first. (#8)
  • aedes_sequential_update() gains version and timestamp arguments so callers can pin all downstream service calls (aedes_xyz2id(), fafbseg::flywire_updateids()) to the same materialisation. Defaults to timestamp = 'now' when neither is supplied. (#8)
  • read_aedes_neurons() wraps fafbseg::read_l2skel() and reroots each neuron via a per-neuron cascade: FlyTable soma_xyz → flywire_nuclei() → the packaged neuropil mesh (signed-distance fallback). Provenance recorded in a soma_source column. (#6)
  • New aedes_soma_position() returns one-row-per-id soma positions, matching strictly by root_id; private helper silently collapses bookkeeping duplicates in the nucleus table and warns only when a root_id has genuinely distinct nuclei. (#6)
  • New aedes_neuropil_mesh dataset: mesh3d of the Aedes brain neuropil (nm coordinates), shipped via LazyData. (#6)
  • New aedes_mirror() and related transforms for mirroring points and objects through the Aedes brain. (#5)
  • aedes_chunkedgraph_edits() fixes data-frame assembly for chunked responses that include empty batches or missing names, and adds incremental on-disk caching for operation fetches (Arrow plus a missing-op sidecar). (#4)
  • aedes_sequential_update() no longer loses work when individual supervoxel lookups fail. (#3)

aedes v0.2

  • Fast supervoxel lookups via the MRC LMB transform service (aedes_xyz2id() with method="auto"), > 100x faster than cloudvolume for bulk queries.
  • also features chunked requests with progress reporting and automatic retry at reduced chunk size on failure.
  • aedes_sequential_update() now uses the fast transform service for supervoxel lookups.
  • aedes_meta() now wraps fafbseg::cam_meta() for metadata queries, with improved documentation of version/timestamp handling.
  • Refactored aedes_cfmeta() column renaming for robustness.
  • Package hygiene: removed unused imports, added glue, httr, nat.utils, pbapply to Imports, pinned fafbseg (>= 0.15.5).

aedes v0.1

  • Initial version on github with basic functions from 2025aedes aedes-dataset-funs.R
  • also has docs at https://flyconnectome.github.io/aedes
